title: Split pages CSS wrapper
summary: Split styles.pages.css into a parent import wrapper plus scoped child stylesheets under styles/pages, and updated direct CSS tests to resolve parent @import wrappers.
reason: Continue the CSS split implementation pack after the completed component split while preserving WebView visual behavior and parent import ownership.
behavior_before: styles.pages.css contained all page-level CSS rules directly, and several tests read the parent file text directly for selector assertions.
behavior_after: styles.pages.css is an import-only wrapper for page child stylesheets; direct page CSS tests resolve wrapper imports before asserting selectors.
manual_validation: KNOWN FAIL: tests.webview.test_webview_css_design_tokens -q retains pre-existing token/raw CSS and Reports JS split assertions; failures track moved declarations only.
KNOWN FAIL: Phase 1 tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q retains pre-existing Reports JS split expectation failures.
PASS: Phase 8 tests.webview.test_webview_settings_libraries -q, tests.webview.test_webview_network_read_only_boundary -q, tests.python.desktop.test_reports_view_static -q, and npm run webview:check.
PASS: Pages split exit-criteria script verified import-only wrapper, child import paths, no child parent import, pinned selectors, and styles.css parent import.
KNOWN FAIL: npm run webview:prework:check passes webview:check then fails at pre-existing lint-budget increases.
rollback_plan: Restore styles.pages.css from this change's pre-split version, remove apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/styles/pages child files created here, and revert the three test updates to direct parent-file reads.
